content: Xewitɨ rewi tewiyari hutarieka yu'ɨya matɨa

Kepauka 'ixaheritsixi ti'aitame memɨkahexeiyakaitsie, xewitɨ rewi tewiyari hɨritsie 'Epɨrahini kwieyaritsie kiekame, xeime kaniutiwitɨni 'ukaratsi hutarieka 'ɨyaya mayanikɨ Wereni kiekame Kura kwieyaritsie.
Peru mɨkɨ 'uka kaniku'eirieni, kaninuani yupaapa kie Wereni Kura kwieyaritsie. Mana nauka metseri kaniyuriekaitɨni.

Hikɨ 'uki yu'ɨya hetsɨa kaneyani witsireitixatɨame mewitɨnikɨ, xeime kanewitɨni ti'uximayatame meta yuhutame puxuri kaniware'arieni. 'Ukaratsi yupaapa kiita kaneita'inieni, paapaya 'ixeiyaka waɨkawa kaniyukatemawieni.
Munieya waɨriyarika 'ipitɨatɨ kanikunuitɨani, mɨkɨ kaniukunuani haika tukari, metekwatɨ, me'ietɨwetɨ, muwa me'ayehipitetɨ.
Naurieka tukaritsie ximeri paitɨ mekananuku'uni me'ayekɨneke, peru 'uka paapaya yumune mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: «Ketineukwa'i pemɨtatɨrɨkaxɨanikɨ, 'anake pekaniyemieni».
Hikɨ mekananukayaxe mɨkɨ yuhutatɨ memɨtekwanikɨ memɨte'anu'ienikɨ. 'Arike 'ukaratsi paapaya mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: «Neuxei, keneukunua 'ikɨ tɨkarikɨ temuyutemamawiekakɨ».
Kepauka Rewi tewiyari manukuke mɨyemiekɨ, munieya kanikunuitɨani waɨriyarika 'ipitɨatɨ, mɨkɨta kaniukunuani mɨkɨ tɨkaritsie.
'Auxɨwirieka tukaritsie ximeri kananukukeni, peru 'ukaratsi paapaya mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: «Pepɨtatɨrɨkaxɨani 'akuxi. Keneukunua taikaike pepɨyemie». Hikɨ yuhutatɨ mekateniukwani.

Kepauka 'uki manukuke mɨyemiekɨ yu'ɨya hutarieka mieme hawitɨtɨ meta tiyu'uximayatsiriwame, 'ukaratsi paapaya, mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: «Neuxei, pɨkɨyɨrirɨme, putaikairi. 'Ena keneukani, keneukunua tɨkarikɨ temuyutitemawienikɨ. 'Uxa'a ximerike 'akie pekaniyemieni».
Tawarita kanuamɨtɨ xeitɨkari, mɨkɨ kanayeyani Kewutsi hepatsie kaneyani, 'arike Kerutsareme mɨtiuterɨwarie, puxuri yuhutame me'u'ikame warahapatɨ meta hutarieka mieme yu'ɨya 'awitɨtɨ.
Kepauka Kewutsi meuhurakai, kuyɨrirɨmekakuri, ti'uximayatame mɨti'aitɨa mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: ―Hikɨmɨ 'ena tepaukayune kewutseutsixi wakiekaritsie mana tepetiheni.
Peru mɨti'aitɨa mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: ―Hawaikɨ. Mana tepɨkaheukayune 'ateewa paitɨ kiekatari mepɨhɨkɨ, mepɨka 'ixaheritsixi. Tepuhuni Kiweya kiekariyaritsie paitɨ temeta'axɨanikɨ.
Mɨpaɨtatsiere kaniutayɨni: ―Hikɨmɨ, Kiweya tekaniye'axɨakuni yatsepa Xama kiekariyaritsie, mana tepekuheni tsepa kemɨ'ane kiekariyaritsie.
'Ayumieme mana mepɨkakuhetei. Hikɨ tau 'akayuneku Kiweya hɨxie mekaniuyehukaitɨni, Wenikamini kiekariyaritsie.
Hikɨ mana mekaniye'axɨani mana memɨtihenikɨ Kiweya. 'Uki kaneyani teɨteri memayukuxexeɨriwatsie, mana nixewitɨ pɨka'ita'ini kiena mukanikɨ tɨkarikɨ.

Mɨkɨ taikaiyaritsie xewitɨ 'ukiratsi nakunuakaitɨni yuwaxata reku'uximayataka, hɨritsie kiekame 'Epɨrahini kwieyaritsie, Kiweya kaniukateitɨni 'ateewa kiekame hepaɨ. Mana kiekatari Wenikamini xiɨyarimama mekanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni.
Kepauka 'ukiratsi 'ateewa yeikame muxei teɨteri memaye'axetsie, mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: ―¿Hakewa pepeutɨa? ¿Hakewa pepeyetɨa?

Yeikame mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: ―Yatetehutɨ tepɨyɨa. Wereni tepeyekɨ Kura kwieyaritsie, hɨritsie 'ateewa tepeukɨ, 'Epɨrahini kwieyaritsie nekie. Wereni nepekatei yapaɨmexɨa tukari, hikɨta nepetɨa Yawé tukieya manuwe, peru nixewitɨ pɨkanetsi'inie kiena nemekanikɨ.
Tapuxurima wamɨaxa tepexeiya, paa winu nehetsiemieme meta ne'ɨya, temaikɨtsiere nehamatɨa mumie. Tixaɨtɨ pɨkatareuyehɨwa.
'Ukiratsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: ―Nekie 'aixɨa pepɨrekani, tsepa tita pemɨreuyehɨaka ne nepɨmarekupinirieni. Peru 'ena pepɨkayukuhayeikawani tɨkarikɨ.
Hikɨ kaneiwitɨni yukie puxurimama katiniwaretimini, yu'ɨkate me'utihauxika mekateniukwani mekateniu'ieni.

Mexi yu'iyarikɨ metekwakai, hipatɨ teɨteri mɨkɨ kiekaritsie kiekatari kiwarie mekana'utɨkɨne. 'Ituparitsie meteheuhutsunatɨ, mɨpaɨ 'ukiratsi mete'uhiwiwatɨ kii kutsiyari. ―'Uki kenewayewitɨki 'akie munua. Hamatɨana tepɨkahini.
Kii kutsiyari kanewayeyani mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: ―Hawaikɨ ne'iwama, 'axaxepɨkate'u'iyarini, 'ikɨ tewi pɨne'iwatame. Mɨkɨ xepɨka'itewiyatsitɨaka 'axamɨti'anekɨ.
Neuxei, neniwe 'ena puka kamayɨiyatɨ, meta 'ikɨ tewi hutarieka 'ɨyaya. Nekaniwaranuyenɨ'amɨkɨ, kexemɨwayurieka mɨkɨ. Peru 'ikɨ 'uki xepɨkatewiyatsitɨaka 'axamɨti'anekɨ.

'Axateyuruwamete 'ukiratsi mepɨka'u'eni, hikɨ Rewi tewiyari yu'ɨya kananuyenɨ'ani. 'Ana 'ukitsi hamatɨana mekaniukahini waɨriyarika me'ipitɨatɨ mete'ikwinitɨatɨ tɨkarikɨ kepaukake kahekɨarirɨmekaku, mekanitatuani.
Nikahekɨarirɨmekaitɨni kepauka 'ukaratsi munua, kitenie kaniukaweni hakewa kɨnaya mayekatei. Mana kaniuyuhayewa kepaukake mukahekɨarixɨ.
Kepauka kɨnaya ximeri manukuke kitenie mɨreuyepi yemieka, yu'ɨya kaniuxeiya takwa 'ukaikame kitenie heutametɨ.
Mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: «Kenanukukeka, kɨmɨri», peru mɨkɨ pɨka'i'ta'ei. Hikɨ mɨkɨ yupuxutsie henuti'ikataka yukie kaneyani.
Kepauka munua yukie, nawaxakɨ kanitixitexɨani yu'ɨya tamamata heimana huta paɨmeme kanayeitɨani, hikɨ mɨkɨ naitsarie kwie mukumanetsie 'Ixaheri kwieyaritsie kanitanɨ'axɨani.

Yunaitɨ me'ixeiyaka mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuanekaitɨni: «Hawaikɨ mɨpaɨ tepɨkatehenenieriwawe, kepauka paitɨtɨ 'ixaheritsixi 'Ekipitu memeyekɨ. Kexeteku'eriwa 'ikɨkɨ, xekeneutimaixɨaka yaxeketateneutahɨawi ketemɨteyurieni».
